legion.spearwatch.name: Spearwatch Legion
legion.spearwatch.text: When defending, add +1 to your first die (max 6).
legion.stormwing.name: Stormwing Legion
legion.stormwing.text: In an attack, reroll your first die once if it shows 1.
legion.ironbull.name: Ironbull Legion
legion.ironbull.text: After a conquest, push at least 2 armies into the taken region.
rule.setup: Claim regions in turn order; garrison 1 army each and keep the rest at your capital.
rule.reinforce: At your turn start take reinforcements: one third of your regions, minimum 3.
rule.bonus: Hold every region of a continent for its bonus; your capital adds +2.
rule.attack: Attack a neighbour: roll up to 3 dice from a region holding 2+ armies.
rule.defend: The defender rolls up to 2 dice.
rule.pairing: Dice pair largest to smallest; every pair costs the loser one army.
rule.ties: Ties go to the defender; fortress regions add +1 to its first die.
rule.conquest: After a conquest move at least as many armies as dice you committed.
rule.trade: Bank 3 banners after reinforcing; the longer the streak the bigger the reward.
rule.legion: Draw 1 legion writ after reinforcing; one legion may be played per turn.
rule.elimination: Losing your last region eliminates you; your banners pass to the conqueror.
rule.end: The last commander standing rules Aetheris; ties go to the shorter campaign.
